name: Crusader's Outpost
summary: In western Tirisfal Glades, Scarlet Crusaders hold a fortified scout tower beside Solliden Farmstead. It marks the Crusade's westernmost position in all of Lordaeron, far from its main bastions and deep in hostile Forsaken territory.

sections.title: A Lonely Watchtower
sections.body: A stone tower rises in the western Tirisfal hills, just north of Deathknell. The Scarlet garrison here marks the farthest reach of the Crusade's power in Lordaeron. Its soldiers work with the surviving human laborers at Solliden Farmstead, trying to hold back the encroaching undead. Lookouts watch the nearby pumpkin fields and forest paths for Scourge fiends and patrols from the Undercity.

sections.title: Isolated Behind Enemy Lines
sections.body: The western frontier leaves the crusaders in a perilous position. Their main strongholds lie at the Scarlet Monastery and far to the east at Tyr's Hand, with no swift reinforcements likely if an attack breaches the palisade. Should Forsaken forces massing across Tirisfal lay siege, the garrison must hold the tower alone or face annihilation before help can arrive.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade all the way out here in western Tirisfal?
faq.answer: The tower is an early warning post and defensive fortification in the western Tirisfal hills. It protects the living human farmers at Solliden Farmstead and watches the western approaches for feral Scourge and Forsaken advance scouts.

faq.q: Can reinforcements reach this outpost if it gets attacked?
faq.answer: Reinforcements cannot reach the outpost easily. It is the westernmost Scarlet holding in Lordaeron, while the Crusade's main bastions lie far to the east at the Scarlet Monastery and Tyr's Hand. If Forsaken forces surround the garrison, it is cut off.

faq.q: What is the relationship between the tower and Solliden Farmstead?
faq.answer: The crusaders have allied with the remaining human farmers at Solliden Farmstead. The soldiers protect them from the walking dead in exchange for sustenance and a loyal staging ground on Lordaeron's fringes.

faq.q: Are there other towers like this in the region?
faq.answer: Yes. The Scarlet Crusade established four similar Crusader's Outposts across Tirisfal Glades to survey and patrol the surrounding lands.

angles.text: As a newly risen Forsaken emerging from Deathknell, you find a nearby tower guarded by Scarlet zealots, an immediate threat on your border.
As a member of the Horde, you see the outpost as a bitter reminder that the Scarlet Crusade refuses to yield Tirisfal to the Forsaken and their allies.
